scientific_question: Is the maximum nearest-compatible-source requirement across observed positive transitions driven by exceptional target patches, or does a large requirement persist when a predeclared small number of positive records are allowed as externally-unexplained?

original_scientific_contract_unchanged.coordinate_correction: multiply 2019 patch_network x,y by 1000 to meters; Euclidean distances then /1000 to km
original_scientific_contract_unchanged.target_rule: recorded population>0 at t and exactly 0 at t-1, valid t-1 host scores and mapped coordinates
original_scientific_contract_unchanged.source_rule: recorded population>0 at eligible source year, valid source-year host scores and mapped coordinates
original_scientific_contract_unchanged.delta_metric: max absolute difference of Plantago and Veronica ordinal habitat scores
original_scientific_contract_unchanged.one_hop_fixed_source: only descriptive, not colonization or dispersal inference

new_primary_estimand.name: k-exception minimum one-hop radius
new_primary_estimand.definition: For n eligible observed positive transitions and declared delta, let d_i(delta)=minimum distance to any eligible source (Infinity if no source). Define r_k(delta) as the (n-k)th order statistic of the n distances; equivalently minimum radius that locally explains >=n-k positives, explicitly retaining k unresolved/external-explanation slots.
new_primary_estimand.unsupported_target_distance: Infinity; radius remains non-estimable unless budget accommodates every unsupported target

predeclared_falsification_checks: for k=0, recomputed counts and r must match frozen parent 12 panels x 4 host thresholds within 1e-5 km; no parent mismatch may be repaired silently
in any fixed year/source/host panel, r_k must weakly decrease with a larger exception allowance
in any fixed year/source/k, r_k must weakly decrease as host tolerance increases
in any fixed year/host/k, adding two-year sources must weakly decrease r_k when target rosters are equal
if k< number of targets with no eligible source, r_k is non-estimable, not zero
no finite r_k=0 may be interpreted as actual zero dispersal; same-site recurrence is an allowed source hypothesis
no statistical p-value, significance, biological prevalence, site-level record or inferred source/movement route is produced
reporting: 12 year/source panels, each 4 host thresholds and all exception budgets with per-panel n targets, n impossible, k, r_k, delta-r from strict when strict is finite
within each panel, empirical median, q90, q95, q99 of finite target-to-source distances and fraction q95/max when strict finite
count of primary panels whose strict radius is reduced >=25% by one exception (predeclared descriptive criterion, not hypothesis test)
count of primary panels that remain undefined at k=0 but become finite with 1% or 5% exception allowance
source-policy and environment-tolerance effects separated; no pooling of individual patches as independent biological replicates
all outputs aggregate-only plus exact source hashes and frozen-parent fingerprint
scientific_stop_rules: STOP_SOURCE_SHA or STOP_TRANSPORT or STOP_PARENT_REPRODUCTION_MISMATCH: do not score/relabel
STOP_INVARIANT_FAILURE: do not publish stronger claim
if no exception-free local explanation, report unresolved explanation requirement
this is post-exposure exploratory sensitivity reusing the same data; no independent EOG-WF endpoint or prospectively confirmed ecological claim
